caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, off-white or beige background. The object is illustrated using black ink lines that vary in thickness, providing detail and shading. The main form consists of a large, conical or bell-shaped base that tapers upward, supporting a cylindrical section topped with a smaller, rounded cap and a flat, circular knob or button at the very top. Extending outward from the midsection of the cylindrical body is a wide, circular opening that resembles a lamp or headlight, with ray-like lines indicating depth and the reflective inner surface. A curved, wire-like handle arches from the back of the cylindrical section to just below the top cap. The entire composition is monochromatic, utilizing only black line work with no additional colors or fills. The drawing is centrally located on the page, with ample empty space surrounding the object.
title: Fire Truck Headlight
